lemma pigeonhole_all_ones {m : ℕ} (ns : Fin m → ℕ)

      rw [h_i_zero]

      exact h0⟩
  have h_sum_one : (∑ _k : Fin m, (1 : ℕ)) = m := by simp
  rw [h_sum_one, h_sum] at h_sum_lt
  linarith
